text: lee: Quick a11y + copy check for the SLO threshold action row. When you open the notification preview the tab order skips the action buttons. Also the small toggle label reads 'Mute' which product thinks is ambiguous in the compact layout. Can folks take a look? tanya: Thanks — can you give repro steps? I want to add an acceptance test. lee: repro: SLOs > Edit threshold > on the action bar click the eye preview. Keyboard: Tab to the eye, Enter to open, then Shift+Tab back. Focus lands inside the preview panel but action bar buttons (Assign owner / Contact) are not reachable until you press Esc. jordi: I can repro. Looks like the preview is implemented as a sibling overlay that steals focus. Modal focus trap is applied to the preview but action bar lives outside. ben: Copy note: Instead of 'Mute' can we use 'Mute for 30m' or 'Pause alerts' ? Shortness is important for the condensed action row. Also for SR we can include an aria-description: aria-describedby="mute-desc" with invisible text. aria-bot: Accessibility check: preview dialog lacks aria-labelledby and its header isn't announced. Also the toggle lacks aria-pressed semantics. Recommend: add role="dialog" with aria-labelledby, use a real toggle button with aria-pressed and aria-describedby for longer context. Add aria-live="polite" to the channel-count element so screen readers announce changes. lee: Good suggestions. For labels I prefer 'Pause alerts' visually with a hidden description: Pause notifications for this SLO for the selected duration tanya: For the keyboard problem we could add a skip link at modal open: Skip to actions. That avoids DOM surgery and is fast to ship. We'll need CSS to make it visible to keyboard. jordi: Implementation detail: ensure the skip link target has tabindex=-1 so we can programmatically focus it. Also ensure the focus trap excludes the action row anchor target. ben: On button copy: change 'Fallback' to 'Fallback policy' and 'Assign' to 'Assign owner' to be explicit for voice readers. Short but clearer. qa-bot: Note for tests: add Cypress scenario that tabs through preview open -> Shift+Tab returns to action row -> Activate mute toggle -> assert aria-pressed toggles and channel count announced. lee: I'll open a small PR with the skip-link, aria-labelledby, aria-pressed on toggle, and the copy swaps. Pinging infra for a deploy preview. tanya: I'll own the cypress test and add a small storybook example for keyboard flows. jordi: I'll follow with a refactor to move action-row into the modal DOM in a follow-up so we don't rely on the skip-link long term. ben: LGTM. When PR is up drop the staging link here and I'll run a quick NVDA/VoiceOver pass. aria-bot: Reminder: ensure the hidden description is in the DOM before the toggle for SRs to pick it up consistently. lee: Thanks everyone. Priorities: skip-link + aria-labelledby + toggle semantics + copy changes for this patch. Follow-up: DOM refactor and e2e coverage. Closing when merged. :white_check_mark:
